messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — hotfix PR #8210 is blocking the Sunday deploy, we need two approvals before 11:00am PST to make the cutoff. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8210 :warning:
Maya: pinged. I can look but need to finish a smoke test first, ETA 25m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam: I can grab it after the meeting in ~15. if it's small I'll approve. any risky db changes?
Jordan: No DB changes — just a regressor config toggle and a small guardrail in the runtime path. Added a short description in the PR.
Alex: sending a quick checklist — can we confirm: 1) unit tests green, 2) e2e smoke pass, 3) rollout canary to 5% then ramp?
Jordan: Tests are green on CI. Smoke on staging still running (started 3m ago). Canary plan is in the PR description.
Maya: skimmed the diff, looks fine. one nit about variable name but not blocking. will give LGTM after smoke completes unless someone objects. :+1:
Sam: reading now. small comment on a log message. if I don't see any issues I'll add my approval in 20m.
DevOps Bot: Deploy window for Sunday cutover: 11:30am-12:30pm PST. Merges must be in main by 11:00am PST to be included.
Priya: If we hit the cutoff, what's rollback plan? need to capture runbook pointers here.
Jordan: Rollback is standard: revert PR and trigger canary rollback job, ops will monitor. linked runbook: https://confluence.redwood/rollbacks#canary
Maya: smoke passed on staging — posting logs snippet:
```
smoke: all checks ok
latency: within threshold
redis-cache-warm: success
```
Maya: LGTM :white_check_mark:
Sam: LGTM as well. merging now. :tada:
Jordan: Thank you both! merging and kicking off canary.
DevOps Bot: Canary deployment started for PR #8210 — 5% traffic. Monitoring: infra, latency, error-rate dashboards.
Alex: will watch dashboards and call rollback if error-rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive mins.
Jordan: will follow up in #incidents if anything noisy. If all good we'll ramp after 15m. :muscle:
